QuestInfo.name: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine
QuestInfo.0: I hear that #p603# in #m10005000# is making a new medicine...
QuestInfo.1: I ran into #b#p603##k in front of the #m10005001# again, the one I helped get herbs for before. This time, he found a new place with a different important herb that he needs for another type of medicine he's working on. He asked me to go back to the forest and grab a #b#t4031026##k for him. It has a reddish root split in two... I should make sure I grab the same exact one once I get to the top. I guess that means I have to go back to #b#p306##k in #m10002000#...
QuestInfo.2: Thankfully, I got the herb that #p603# asked me to get, and for that, I was rewarded with a mysterious rock. And from here on out, I don't have to pay #p306# every time I go in the Forest of Patience. From what I hear, that anti-aging medicine #p603# is working on may be what #p306# needed... If I have time, I should go back in there...

0.0: Ohhh, you're the traveler that helped me out the other day! I made the diet medicine with the herbs you got me and made some money... This time, I'd like to make a different kind of a medicine. What do you think? Do you want to help me out one more time?

yes.0: Thank you. The place where you can find the mysterious herb is actually somewhere you've been before, #m10002000#. I heard someone's accepting an entrance fee at the entrance... You have the mesos to go in, right? This time you'll be going in much deeper than before, so be prepared...
yes.1: Yes! Let me explain more about the herb you'll be getting for me. There are similar ones around, so make sure you memorize this. The herb you'll need to get is a #b#t4031026##k, and the root looks like this: #i4031026#. Search carefully and please get the exact one I described for you.

no.0: Really. You look like you'd just breeze through there... Please come back here when you have time. I'll be waiting for you.

1.0: Ohhh... This is IT! With #b#t4031026##k, I can finally make the anti-aging medicine!!! Hahaha, if you ever become old and weak, find me. By then, I may have a special medicine for just that!
1.1: Oh, I almost forgot. Since you helped me out, I should thank you for your hard work... This #b#t4020109##k is something I found at the very bottom of a valley a long time ago, in the middle of a journey. It'll probably help you down the road. I also increased your Fame, and, from here on out, #p306# will let you in for free. Well, so long...

item.0: You haven't gotten the herb yet. The herb you need to get is a #b#t4031026##k. The roots should look like this: #i4031026#. Memorize this, and go to #p306# in #m10002000# to get there.
